title: CAME quote-free normalized forecast trace row
description: Complete field contract for one CSV row. Numeric, integer, and Boolean fields permit their CSV string serialization.

guidance_availability.description: Available management-guidance category at the forecast origin.

actual.description: Reported target-quarter revenue in the company reporting currency.

baseline_prediction.description: Compatibility numeric baseline from the shared forecast input table; not the direct same-task LLM comparator.

pre_ram_prediction.description: CAME prediction before the anchor-memory admission step.

final_came_prediction.description: Final public CAME prediction and replay reference value.

compressed_base_delta_log.description: Natural-log correction from the historical compressed-base execution channel.

compressed_base_support.description: Support assigned to the historical compressed-base execution channel.

intrinsic_delta_log.description: Natural-log correction from current normalized evidence.

intrinsic_support.description: Support assigned to the current-evidence residual channel.

temporal_delta_log.description: Natural-log correction from typed temporal memory.

temporal_support.description: Support assigned to typed temporal memory.

guidance_delta_log.description: Natural-log correction from the explicit-guidance residual channel.

guidance_support.description: Support assigned to the explicit-guidance residual channel.

guidance_active.description: One when the explicit-guidance residual channel is active, otherwise zero.

base_weight.description: Effective blend weight for the historical base execution channel.

intrinsic_weight.description: Effective blend weight for the current-evidence residual channel.

temporal_weight.description: Effective blend weight for typed temporal memory.

guidance_weight.description: Effective blend weight for the explicit-guidance residual channel.

blend_support_sum.description: Sum of recorded effective channel supports in the blend trace.

ram_active.description: One when anchor memory admits the upstream proposal, otherwise zero.

ram_reason.description: Exact compatibility reason emitted by the anchor-memory admission step.

ram_history_n.description: Number of prior eligible no-guidance observations available to anchor memory.

ram_prior_signed_log_error.description: Prior-only signed log-error statistic; blank when unavailable.

normalized_card_ids_json.description: JSON array of normalized evidence-card identifiers linked to the trace.

normalized_card_count.description: Number of linked normalized evidence cards.
